about: One pinned short that shows how to read the readout (src/scenes/Readout.tsx), which 35 shorts use. The user, 2026-09-27: 'we probably need an explainer video then for each of the styles? or are all of the styles pretty self explanatory except for the nostromo wang bi shorts'. The example is 22 Grace: line 5 is yin, OUT of place, yet a centre and the master.
look: The readout's own screen with 22's plot, fully built from the start, the plot keeping its slow turn. The WANG BI line and the finding show dimmed, as on the real 22 screen; the lesson line is left out, and each step's text is typed in its place at the prompt, plain white with no glow, so it reads as the explainer and not the readout. The part a step explains goes to full green while the rest dims; amber only where the real screen uses it (the ◄ lines, blinking as in the shorts, and the WANG BI line), in the last two steps.

caption: How to read the green screen in 35 of our shorts, using 22 Grace. The in/out rule comes from the Ten Wings; Wang Bi (AD 226–249) applied it only to lines 2 to 5.
